site_definition: Retail perfumery stores operated in the France segment, which Douglas reports as FR plus Monaco. Store = a trading location, not a concession counter.
note: Declared 170 was the Douglas-branded count and missed Nocibe, acquired 2014 and operated alongside it. Two FY publications agree within a 427-432 band. The declared figure was wrong, not the research.

site_definition: The UPS Store retail network. Franchised: independently owned and operated, so the connectivity is the franchisee's cost and not UPS's.
note: Research counted them correctly; they are not UPS's estate. Without the exclusion the footprint went from 1038 to 6692 and priced 5603 retail circuits UPS does not buy.

site_definition: Customer locations UNFI SUPPLIES - independent retailers buying wholesale from it. Not sites it operates. Its own banners, Cub Foods and Shoppers, are declared separately at 75.
note: Superseded the declared 75 by 800x. The simulation refused the row at its 50000-per-row cap, which is the only reason it surfaced as an error rather than as an estate.

site_definition: Financial centres, which research types as STORE and this company declares as BRANCH. The same 230-branch network under a second name.
note: Research returned a 222 national total and a six-state breakdown of the same branches. Promoting either would count branches already declared as BRANCH a second time.

site_definition: UK health and beauty stores. Definition unsettled between sources: one count appears to include Boots Opticians as separate sites and one does not.
note: Promotion refused on a 49% source conflict, 1452 against 2164. Boots UK runs about 1800 and the declared 1750 sits inside that spread, so the declared figure stands unchanged and unverified.

site_definition: German builders' merchant distribution branches. Divested: sold to STARK Group in 2019, so they are not Saint-Gobain sites and their connectivity is not its cost.
note: Research labelled the finding "DIVESTED to STARK Group 2019 - no longer..." and promotion carried only (country, archetype, sites). The disqualification was in the evidence and the pipeline discarded the words.

site_definition: UK builders' merchant distribution branches (Jewson and related). Divested to STARK Group in 2023. The French merchants are retained and remain declared.
note: Same mechanism as the German branches. 820 sites across the two were priced as Saint-Gobain's for the life of this sample set.

site_definition: Fintro branches in Belgium. A franchise network of independently operated agents, so the connectivity is the franchisee's cost. BNP's own retained Belgian branches are declared separately.
note: Research labelled it "STORE (Fintro franchise branches)" and the word franchise did not survive promotion - the same failure as the UPS Store network.

site_definition: German production sites. The researched 54 is labelled "all site types, Germany" - plants, offices and data centres together - and the declaration already carries offices and DCs separately.
note: Promoting an all-types total into one archetype made the German estate 73 against a source that says the whole of it is 54. The declared 40 plants stands.

site_definition: US distribution centres operated. The researched 4 counts CLOSURES and consolidations in FY2026 - Allentown PA, a west-region DC, Racine/Sturtevant WI - not sites held.
note: Sites being shut, added to the estate as if they were sites gained. A separate finding records 2 openings; neither is a count of what UNFI operates.

site_definition: German manufacturing sites. The researched 95 is a 2016 factory count the finding itself labels a lower bound.
note: Ten years old and predating the Siemens Energy spin-off in 2020 and the Healthineers listing, both of which moved manufacturing out of the group. The declared 35 stands.

site_definition: Shell-branded retail fuel sites in the Netherlands. Branded does not mean operated: most are dealer-owned forecourts carrying the Shell brand.
note: Whether a dealer forecourt's connectivity is Shell's cost is a scope decision, not a fact. Shell often retains the payment network while the dealer owns the site. Left in the estate pending an owner ruling; the same question applies to its German 1,916.

site_definition: DHL Express service and drop-off points in Great Britain. Overwhelmingly counters hosted inside third-party retailers rather than DHL premises.
note: Reads like the UPS Store network, which was excluded. The difference is that a ServicePoint may run on DHL-provided scanning connectivity rather than the host's. An owner ruling decides it.

site_definition: Allianz France tied-agent offices (agences). Self-employed agents operating their own premises under the Allianz brand.
note: Unlike a franchise, a tied agent usually sits on the insurer's network for policy systems, so the connectivity plausibly is Allianz's cost. The single largest change in the set, on one uncorroborated source with a bare STORE label and an as_of of only a year.

site_definition: A Nestle-owned or attributed data centre in Germany. The finding describes a 2002 IBM-era regional DC from the outsourcing arrangement of that period.
note: Twenty-four years old. Its Swiss sibling at Bussigny carries the same 2002 date and the words "sold to Orllati", and a third finding records no Nestle-owned DC in France at all. The DC evidence for this company describes an estate since disposed of.

site_definition: The Energy Transition Campus Amsterdam, Shell's Dutch technology campus - one site, operated by Shell.
note: Flagged as stale at four years old, and the date is an opening rather than a count going out of date: the campus opened in 2022 under that name and the finding records when it began, not when somebody last looked. Staleness is not the right objection here.
